cards.audioText: You are estimating WXI at time 34 maintaining 11000m, squawk 6527. Contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计到达WXI时间34分，11000米保持，应答机6527，联系郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, ETA WXI 34 maintaining 11000m, squawk 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，预计到达WXI时间34分，11000米保持，应答机6527。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce Mach .75, due Wuhan Control restrictions.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，郑州区调，雷达已识别，向右偏3海里，由于武汉区调限制，马赫数减小至点75。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce Mach .75, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏3海里，马赫数减小至点75，美联航865。

cards.audioText: Adverse weather ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20nm deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方天气状况恶劣，向郑州区调请求向右偏20海里并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, request 20nm deviation right of track due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，由于天气原因，请求向右偏20海里。

cards.audioText: UAL865, 20nm deviation to the right approved, report clear of weather.[Tell the controller you are cleared of weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，可以向右偏20海里，天气好转报告。【告诉管制员天气好转。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, clear of weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，脱离天气。

cards.audioText: UAL865, the restriction still exists, reduce Mach number .72 [Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，限制仍有效，减小马赫数至点72。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Reduce to Mach.72, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减小马赫数至点72，美联航865。

cards.audioText: Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach .72 is not acceptable which is too slow for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉郑州区调马赫数点72对你的飞机来说太慢了。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, we cannot accept Mach .72, too slow for us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，我们不能接受马赫数点72，对我们来说太慢了。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach .75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due Wuhan radar failure.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，郑州区调，马赫数点75保持，由于武汉雷达失效，我们正在限制武汉管制区内飞行的飞机数量。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger. Maintaining Mach .75, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，马赫数点75保持，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, report estimated time of OBLIK.[Inform Zhengzhou control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，报告预计到达OBLIK时间。【通知郑州区调，预计到达OBLIK时间为06:38。】
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 0638, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计到达OBLIK时间为06:38，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, make a right orbit due spacing, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.[Tell Zhengzhou Control, you are the international flight, you can't hold for a long time due to fuel limitation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，由于间隔，右转机动，到达OBLIK时间不早于06:46。‘【告诉郑州区调，你们是国际航班，由于油量限制，你们不能长时间盘旋等待。】
cards.referenceText: Orbit right due spacing, over OBLIK not early than 0646, we are an international flight, we cannot hold for a long time due fuel limitation, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于间隔，右转机动，到达OBLIK时间不早于06:46，我们是一架国际航班，由于油量限制，我们不能长时间等待，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, confirm the fuel endurance?[Tell the controller the fuel endurance is 45min, you can't hold more than 30min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，证实燃油续航时间。【告诉管制员燃油续航时间为45分钟，飞机不能盘旋等待超过30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 45min, negative hold more than 30min, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间45分钟，不能盘旋等待超过30分钟，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, I can't tell you the exactly time of hold, do you need declare an emergency fuel?[Tell controller you can hold for now, inform the latest notice as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，我无法确定等待时间，你需要宣布紧急燃油么？【告诉管制员你现在还可以等待，请求尽快通知下一指令。】
cards.referenceText: We can hold now, please acknowledge the time as soon as possible, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们现在还能等待，请尽快确认等待时间，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, make a standard hold at present position.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，在原地标准等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Make a standard hold at present position, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地标准等待，美联航865。

cards.audioText: After hold 20min, ask controller how long will you delay for the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 等待20分钟后，询问管制员航班还要延误多久。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, confirm how long shall we hold?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，证实下还要等待多久？

cards.audioText: UAL865, negative time. Do you want to divert to alternation or declare an emergency fuel?[Ask controller which airport is suitable for divert to and is there any delay for the alternation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，不能确定。你想改航到备降机场或是宣布紧急燃油状态么？【询问管制员哪个机场适合备降以及备降机场是否有延误。】
cards.referenceText: Confirm which airport is available for us, and is there any delay for the alternation, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 证实哪个机场适合我们改航，备降机场是否有延误。美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Xinzheng is available for you to divert. Say intentions.[Xinzheng airport is not the regular airport for your company, you need to ask permission and tell controller later.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，新郑机场适合改航。请示意图。【新郑机场不是你公司的常用机场，你需要获得公司许可后再回复管制员。】
cards.referenceText: We need to ask permission to divert to the airport, standby, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要获得公司的许可才能改航，稍等，美联航865。

cards.audioText: After you get the permission, you can divert to Xinzheng, tell ATC you can fly to Zhengzhou and ask for help to Xinzheng.
cards.audioTextZh: 获得许可之后，你可以改航到新郑机场，告诉ATC你可以飞往新郑机场，并请求帮助前往机场。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, we can divert to Xinzheng, request radar vector.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，我们可以改航至新郑机场，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: UAL865, roger. Standby.[A few minutes later.]UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, Wuhan is available, do you want to continue fly to Wuhan?[Ask controller you want to fly to Wuhan and ask for direct to Wuhan due to the hold for a long time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，收到。稍等。【几分钟后。】美联航865，郑州区调，武汉可以飞了，你想继续飞往武汉么？【告诉管制员你想飞往武汉，另外因为等待时间太久，请求直飞武汉。】
cards.referenceText: Request direct to Wuhan due long time delay, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于等待太久，请求直飞武汉，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, direct to IAF of runway 36R, contact Wuhan Control 125.5.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，直飞IAF，跑道36右，联系武汉区调125.5。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Direct to IAF of runway 36R, Wuhan Control 125.5, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞IAF，跑道36右，联系武汉区调125.5，美联航865。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Control, you are directing to IAF of runway 36R, declare you are minimum fuel. Ask to direct to FAF of runway 36R. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉区调，你正在直飞IAF，跑道36右，宣布最低燃油状态。请求直飞FAF，跑道36右。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, UAL865, minimum fuel, request direct to FAF of runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，美联航865，最低燃油，请求直飞FAF，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, direct to FAF of runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，直飞FAF，跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Direct to FAF of runway 36R, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞FAF，跑道36右，美联航865。
